# Evidence Ledger Before Source Writing

The Awtsmoos renews every fact, so memory must bow before what disk and runtime show;
Awtsmoos.com moves by witnessed paths and working receipts, not by confidence alone.

## Direct observations

### Repository and concurrency
- Repository inspected through the live native Mac tunnel at `work/awtsmoos.com/geelooy`.
- Git working tree contains extensive unrelated and parallel uncommitted work.
- Multiple live agents are modifying movie/studio/core paths; destructive reset/stash/revert is forbidden.
- `apps/awtsmoos-studio` was absent at first inspection and appeared during this session from a parallel agent.
- `libs/awtsmoos-ui`, `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core`, `apps/shared/movie`, and Procedural Core `movieAssets` also landed/evolved during this session.

### Existing movie-capable applications
Observed distinct specialist apps include:
- `apps/animator`
- `apps/nesher-studio`
- `apps/video-editor`
- `apps/mitzvah-studio`
- `apps/captions/video`
- `apps/awtsmoos-studio`

### Canonical dependency direction
Observed current adapter imports prove `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core` is already consumed by:
- Nesher movie adapter
- Video Editor movie adapter
- Animator unified-movie adapter
- flagship bridge/proof code in several paths

Other current adapters still consume `apps/shared/movie`; therefore it cannot be removed safely in this pass.

### Canonical movie core observed behavior
`libs/awtsmoos-movie-core` currently provides:
- canonical movie defaults/version/modes
- feature catalog
- validation
- easing/interpolation/keyframe evaluation
- active-scene and exact-time evaluation
- AI intent normalization/compilation
- personality registry
- Canvas movie/entity/particle rendering

`MovieTimelineEvaluator` uses half-open scene intervals and returns the final scene at the exact movie duration.

`CanvasMovieRenderer` genuinely paints canonical evaluated frames into a Canvas and uses the same timeline evaluator for seek/play/export-oriented frame evaluation.

`CanvasEntityRenderer.js` is currently 145 lines, above the user's desired source-file ceiling. It also draws `mesh` as pseudo-depth and `character` as a stick-like 2D figure; these cannot be described as true 3D or rich procedural people.

### Procedural Core movie foundry
`libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/core/movieAssets/` currently provides:
- renderer-neutral recipes
- deterministic semantic seed/random
- particle generation
- character rig descriptors
- infographic marks
- tutorial steps
- geometry/mesh descriptors
- generation provenance receipts

The broader Procedural Core already contains much richer geometry, human, animation, material, camera, vegetation, building, particle, physics, and WebGL/WebGPU systems. The movie foundry should bridge into those public capabilities over time rather than reimplement them.

### UI systems
Capitalized `libs/AwtsmoosUI` currently provides:
- reactive cloned store
- named action registry
- JSON-like node factory
- conditions/repeaters/state reads
- DOM renderer

Lowercase `libs/awtsmoos-ui` currently provides stronger safety and reusable studio primitives:
- safe tag validation
- URL/attribute/style policies
- safe DOM and HTML renderers
- command registry
- component registry
- studio shell/toolbar/panel/tabs/card primitives
- mobile-first responsive tokens

Current flagship imports only the capitalized UI. Therefore the repo currently has duplicated UI responsibilities.

### Flagship runtime gap
Observed `apps/awtsmoos-studio` currently has:
- mobile-oriented panels and timeline strip
- JSON editor
- 12-scene / 180-second showcase data
- Play/Pause/seek controls
- capability bridge

But current Play toggles state without an actual playback clock, and current stage contains CSS orb/person placeholders rather than a bound movie renderer.

### Proof movie fixture
Current flagship showcase test verifies:
- exact 180-second duration
- 12 scenes
- 2D/3D/hybrid mode labels
- required entity/layer categories
- cameras
- particles
- two characters

This is contract evidence only, not proof of actual true-3D pixels or encoded video.

### Export capability
Observed existing real export infrastructure includes:
- Animator `WebCodecsMovieExporter`, `AnimatorMovieExportEngine`, EBML/WebM muxer, browser worker/export controller, production frame sources, headless WebCodecs render runners, FFmpeg packaging tools, prior export result artifacts.
- Nesher Studio WebCodecs renderer, H264/AAC, MP4/WebM container support, export pipeline/queue/presets, browser export plans.

Therefore writing another encoder would be unjustified. The missing work is a canonical frame-source/provider bridge plus actual invocation/verification.

## Inferences kept separate from evidence
- `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core` should become the canonical movie contract because current import direction already points there. This is architectural inference supported by observed consumers, not a formal repository policy document.
- Lowercase `libs/awtsmoos-ui` should become canonical because its safety and studio primitives are stronger; current capitalized UI remains necessary for compatibility until migrated.
- A true-3D flagship adapter should reuse Animator/Procedural Core rather than Canvas pseudo-mesh. Exact host remains to be selected from fresh source inspection after the first safe runtime modules land.

## Known risks before writes
- Parallel agent may modify any contested flagship/layout/shared entry file between read and write.
- Existing duplicate Animator movie adapters could diverge further.
- Existing shared/movie and library-core protocols have different document shapes.
- Capital/lowercase UI naming can cause case-sensitive deployment bugs.
- `CanvasEntityRenderer.js` violates current line-count policy and needs splitting if touched.
- Real export may depend on browser WebCodecs availability and/or local FFmpeg; capability must be probed, not assumed.

## Mutation policy for this pass
- Prefer entirely new files first.
- Immediately reread and hash every existing file immediately before a full rewrite.
- Never partial-patch source.
- Never rewrite another agent's dirty layout file merely for convenience.
- After first source pass, reread all touched files and write a new delta artifact before fixes/tests.
